prompt:

A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Beijing as her world knows it — a city of an imperial Chinese myth-world: vermilion-lacquered wood and carved white stone, roofs of glazed tile, latticed paper windows, glowing painted beams, silk, lantern-light and drifting cloud-shaped lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the palace roofs, the temple hall or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Season: summer — hot, humid monsoon days, heavy air and sudden rain.
Weather: a heavy summer downpour — warm rain drumming on the grey-tiled roofs and the lanes running wet.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Lucrecia Crescent from Final Fantasy VII — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a high-cut one-piece swimsuit, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

SUPPORT: the lounger supports her back and head.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the left of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds an ice cream cone at chest height; it is all she holds.

GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it, and not the object she holds in it; only the costume's own pieces.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
